status: draft labels, self-assigned 2026-10-01, written before any inference. Buckets follow Pat's tiers: small = under 5 kg, moderate = 5 to 15 kg (both ends included), large = over 15 kg, none_stated = no order amount. A per-week or per-month amount is bucketed by the stated amount itself. Sample quantities are not orders and are labelled none_stated. A null label is genuinely ambiguous and skipped.
